diagnostic:
S3 REWORK 2 of the two non-blocking implementation findings of the accepted whole-candidate review at b61593f; the oracle is untouched and behaviour is unchanged (us-iis-07 stayed 29 of 29 scenarios and 513 of 513 steps on the final bytes). The record's file list is the cumulative S3 one; this rework touched five of its entries, all under crates/foundry-app/src/integrations/.

F1, the missing StartOverConfirmation carrier, implemented as the design names it (D6, ADR-IIS-SKR-001). secrets_key_rotation.rs gains StartOverConfirmation, a value with a private unit field and one constructor, StartOverConfirmation::typed(field) -> Option<Self>, which keeps the shipped rule (trim, then the exact words START OVER) and admits nothing else; the words live in it as its own constant. UnopenableOffer::confirms(&str) -> bool is deleted, so no boolean validator remains beside the evidence path. The value is carried to the apply: handlers/secrets_key.rs binds it with a let-else that answers the confirm page again where the field was wrong, empty or absent, and passes it to started_over(.., confirmed) and on to the port; store_capabilities.rs InstanceKeyWrites::start_over_secrets_key takes confirmed: StartOverConfirmation as its first parameter, so rustc refuses the apply to a caller that holds none. The StoreCapabilities implementation spends it (_confirmed) and forwards nothing: the store write does not re-check the words, and the gate it does re-read inside its locked transaction is the live-replica one, unchanged. Claim strength: construction is centralised in mainstream Rust, not proved; the bypasses left open are a future looser public constructor outside this crate and any caller that builds the value from its own parse, both named in the type's doc; the store write below the seam still does not see the words.

F1 side effect, forced and recorded: with the confirmation added, the port method reached eight parameters and cargo clippy denied clippy::too_many_arguments (observed: the first smoke attempt failed at cargo clippy with status 101). Rather than suppress the lint, the key, its canary and the compared stored key id moved into StartOverPlan, the carrier D6 already names beside ReplacePlan: StartOverPlan::of(instance, from_key_id, wrapped_by, actor) -> Option<Self> over the unchanged plan_generate reuse, with from_key_id(), key() and canary() readers and no Debug. The port now reads start_over_secrets_key(confirmed, plan, actor, at, gate); the two test doubles (handlers/secrets_key.rs tests, worker.rs retention_tests) follow. No store SQL, no store signature and no route changed.

F2, the per-render SELECT ... FOR UPDATE on integration_replica_states. The owner of the fact is where the fact is decided: UnopenableOffer gains reads_gate(mode, key_file), a pure predicate that follows decide's own table - the gate decides a word only for a stored key this server cannot open with a key file that is not Withheld - and handlers/instance.rs answer() reads the replica rows only there, passing None otherwise, which is exactly the reading of_gate already turns into RestoreOnly. The alternative of an inline key-mode comparison in the renderer was rejected because it would have put that fact in a second place; a PageRead list for the instance page was rejected because that page also makes reads the list does not model and is answered after writes, so it is no ReadOnlyDoor. The coupling is now asserted inside the existing table test the_table_of_the_three_i26_states (no new test function): for every mode and key file, reads_gate is true exactly where flipping the gate changes the offer, and where it is false of_gate with an unread gate equals decide; the oracle keeps observing the behaviour through the public port.

Commands, all in the Lima VM through scripts/test-in-lima.sh, each exit observed: cargo test -p foundry-app --lib integrations:: exit 0, 95 passed, 0 failed (broader than the declared integrations::secrets_key_rotation selection, which it contains); cargo test -p foundry-store --test iis_instance_store exit 0, 19 passed, 0 failed; cargo xtask check-arch exit 0, boundary guard PASSED including integrations-seal-fence; eip_warm then eip_lane us-iis-07 exit 0, 1 feature, 29 scenarios (29 passed), 513 steps (513 passed); cargo fmt --all -- --check exit 0 and cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets exit 0 after the StartOverPlan change; cargo xtask smoke exit 0, xtask smoke :: all gates green, on the final Mac bytes (the Mac files were compared byte for byte with the VM's formatted copies, which are identical). Nothing was committed. No refactor commit was needed: the two changes are the findings themselves, not preparatory refactors.
